summary: Brunswick County tower near Shallotte, tagged observation on OSM; a 2023 state groundwater map labels a fire tower there. No build date or height found.

events.note: A state groundwater site map dated 09-26-2023 labels a fire tower northwest of Shallotte, with coordinates about 30 m from the OpenStreetMap point.

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap node name is Shallotte Lookout Tower
OpenStreetMap tags the node tower:type observation
TopoQuest places a tower in Brunswick County, NC
evidence.quote: Shallotte Lookout Tower is a tower located in Brunswick County, NC

evidence.supports: Groundwater site map labels a fire tower
Fire tower is northwest of Shallotte
State lookout list gives Shallotte at 33.99166, -78.43861 in Brunswick County
TopoQuest tower coordinates match the OpenStreetMap point

resolved_conflicts.explanation: OpenStreetMap tags the structure as an observation tower; the 2023 map labels it a fire tower. The sources do not say which use applied, so the story reports both labels.
TopoQuest gives 68 ft MSL and OpenStreetMap gives 19 m for the same point. The two differ by about 1.7 m. Elevation is not used in the story.

notes_for_editor: Only three pages. No build date, height, builder, staffing or current status found. A search snippet claimed a 1990 Brunswick Beacon item named a woman who staffed the Shallotte Forest Service tower; the fetched page (newspapers.digitalnc.org, 1990-04-05, seq-2) contains only page text with no tower mention, so the staffing claim is unverified and left out. The NC lookout list (tnlandforms.us) lists Shallotte NCT161 at 33.99166,-78.43861, consistent with the other coordinates; it is cited in the story as source 4. The NCFS Brunswick contact page mentions no tower. The Wikipedia Shallotte article mentions no tower. The 2023 map coordinates are within about 30 m of the OSM point, and the map header pair is the one used. A second map coordinate pair (33.991471, -78.438373) is about 40 m away and was not used. Access and rental unknown.
